b.sound: What living things existed in the past.

instruction.text: Drag the stages of fossilisation into the correct order.

atoms.text: An organism dies and the soft parts of its body rot away.
The hard parts of its body, like the skeleton, are buried by sediment.
The sediment around the skeleton compresses into rock.
Water seeps through the rock and breaks down the skeleton.
Minerals in the water replace the skeleton to form a fossil.

instruction.text: Drag the features to the correct fossils.

atoms.a: Fossils with sharp teeth were once herbivorous animals.
Fossils with fins were once marine animals.
Fossils with wings were once animals that lived in the sea.
Mary Anning was a paleontologist who discovered lots of fossils.
